name: Pix Payment Gateway for WooCommerce
author: linknacional

sections.description:
Integrate Pix or Pix with PagHiper into your WooCommerce store and enable your customers to pay via Pix.

PagHiper PagHiper is a payment platform that provides a secure and efficient payment gateway for businesses to accept Pix payments in Brazil. When a customer chooses Pix as the payment method, transaction data is securely sent to PagHiper to process the payment.
– PagHiper’s Privacy Policy
– PagHiper’s Terms of Service

Dependencies

Pix Payment Gateway for WooCommerce plugin is dependent on WooCommerce plugin, please make sure WooCommerce is installed and properly configured before starting Pix Payment Gateway for WooCommerce installation.

User instructions

  1. Search the WordPress sidebar for ‘Pix Payment Gateway for WooCommerce’.

  2. In the WooCommerce options, navigate to ‘Payments’ and then proceed to the settings for ‘Pix’ or ‘Pix with PagHiper’ as your preferred choice.

  3. Configure the required credentials for your selected payment gateway.

  4. Save your settings.

You have successfully configured Pix Payment Gateway for WooCommerce and enabled your customers to pay via Pix.

Usage

Payments Settings

  1. After installing the plugin, access the WordPress admin dashboard and navigate to the WooCommerce settings.
  2. In the sidebar menu, click on “WooCommerce” and then on “Settings”.
  3. In the “Payments” tab, you’ll see a list of available payment methods.
  4. Locate “Pix” or “Pix with PagHiper” in the list of payment methods and go to settings.
  5. Enter the required configuration information for each payment method.
  6. After configuring the payment methods, make sure to activate each one by toggling the switch.
sections.installation:
1. Look in the sidebar for the WordPress plugins area;

  2. In installed plugins look for the ‘add new’ option in the header;

  3. Click on the ‘submit plugin’ option in the page title and upload the payment-pix-for-woocommerce-master.zip plugin;

  4. Click on the ‘install now’ button and then activate the installed plugin;

The Pix Payment Gateway for WooCommerce plugin is now live and working.
